command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- identity ---'
getent passwd inventorysvc || true
getent group inventory-readers || true
printf '%s\n' '--- directory metadata ---'
ls -ld /srv/inventory
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y %m %u %g %p\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- acl ---'
getfacl -R -p /srv/inventory 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- filesystems/options ---'
findmnt -T /srv/inventory -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
printf '%s\n' '--- boot/services/listeners ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
systemctl --failed --no-legend || true
systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-legend --no-pager
ss -lntup

command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- content checksums before repair ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum
if ! getent group inventory-readers >/dev/null; then groupadd --system inventory-readers; fi
if ! getent passwd inventorysvc >/dev/null; then useradd --system --gid inventory-readers --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /sbin/nologin inventorysvc; fi
chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
chmod -R u=rwX,g=rX,o= /srv/inventory
printf '%s\n' 'repair applied'
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventory-readers

find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y %m %u %g %p\n' | sort

printf '%s\n' '--- boot and required services baseline ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
